dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Liuli Pavilion Ad
dialogues.text: Come enjoy the delicacies of the land — colorful and savory!

dialogues.speaker: Liuli Pavilion Ad
dialogues.text: All kinds of Li-Style cuisine converge at Liuli Pavilion, delighting one with diverse flavors that are all of subtle, spicy, and fragrant.

dialogues.speaker: Liuli Pavilion Ad
dialogues.text: To dine in, please reserve a table at least three months in advance. Thank you for your understanding.
